sahneler.metin: During rush hour, a freeway bridge fell into the Mississippi River.
Cars plunged with it, and thirteen people were killed.
The cause had been in the drawings for forty years.
Steel gusset plates were designed only half as thick as needed.
Over time, extra concrete added weight to the deck.
That day, construction materials were parked right above a weak plate.
The plate buckled, and the main span fell.
Now gusset plates are checked in every truss bridge rating.

aciklama:
I-35W Bridge dropped into the Mississippi River during rush hour. The cause: undersized gusset plates failing under added dead load and construction materials.
